top_signals.title: Blackstone Said to Buy $25 Billion HSBC Australia Home Loan Book
top_signals.summary: Blackstone Inc. has agreed to acquire an about A$36 billion ($25 billion) home loan portfolio in Australia from HSBC Holdings Plc, people familiar with the matter said, in what’s set to be one of the largest such transactions ever.
